meaning.en: A fleshy or waxlike membrane at the base of the upper beak in certain birds, such as parrots, through which the nostrils open.

meaning.en: A waxy, often brightly colored, fleshy area at the base of the beak of some birds, as the parrot, eagle, hawk, etc.: it contains the nostrils.

sentences.en: Descending rapidly from its source, sometimes over cascades, the river soon enters deep gorges through which it flows as far as Beaulieu (department of Correze) where it debouches into a wide and fertile valley and is shortly after joined by the Cere.
